svg.title: Ball return systems
svg.text: Ball return systems of the ball nut – side view (nut transparent, screw axis horizontal); loaded path = solid, unloaded return = accent dashed
axial return hole in the nut body
the nut wall – the nut OD
the axis in the nut wall
Ball path short → small speed variation
+ standard for ground C3 / C5 nuts
− deflector = weak point at overspeed / crash
Use: machine tools, robots, precision axes
+ best for high speed + large lead (20 – 40)
− long return path, more balls not loaded
− end caps wear at very high speed
Tongue lifts the balls out of the groove
− tongue breaks at high speed / crash
Use: rolled C7 screws, presses, handling
